title: JEPA-Bisim: Learning Robust Visual Representations for Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.18639v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World models learned from high-dimensional visual observations allow agents to make decisions and plan directly in latent space, avoiding pixel-level reconstruction. However, recent latent predictive architectures (JEPAs), including the DINO world model (DINO-WM), display a degradation in test time robustness due to their sensitivity to ``slow features". These include visual variations such as background changes and distractors that are irrelevant to the task being solved. We address this limitation by augmenting the predictive objective with a bisimulation encoder that enforces control-relevant state equivalence, mapping states with similar transition dynamics to nearby latent states while limiting contributions from slow features. We evaluate our model on a navigation task (PointMaze) and on a manipulation task (PushT) under different test-time background changes and visual distractors. translated_title: JEPA-Bisim：基于联合嵌入预测世界模型学习鲁棒视觉表示以支持规划
translated_abstract: 从高维视觉观测中学习的世界模型使智能体能够直接在潜空间中进行决策与规划，从而避免像素级重建。然而，近期的潜空间预测架构（JEPAs），包括DINO世界模型（DINO-WM），由于对“慢特征”的敏感性，在测试时表现出鲁棒性下降。这些慢特征包括背景变化以及与所解决任务无关的干扰物等视觉变化。我们通过在预测目标中引入双模拟编码器来解决这一局限，该编码器强制执行与控制相关的状态等价性，将具有相似转移动态的状态映射到相近的潜在状态，同时限制慢特征的贡献。我们在导航任务和操作任务上，在不同测试时背景变化和视觉干扰条件下评估了我们的模型。在所有基准测试中，我们的模型始终（保持一致的优越表现）……
tldr: 提出JEPA-Bisim，通过在联合嵌入预测世界模型中引入双模拟编码器来抑制慢特征的干扰，将具有相似转移动态的状态映射到相近的潜在空间，从而显著提升智能体在背景变化和视觉干扰下的测试时鲁棒性和规划能力。
en_tdlr: JEPA-Bisim augments joint-embedding predictive world models with a bisimulation encoder that suppresses slow features by mapping states with similar transition dynamics to nearby latent states, achieving robust visual representations for planning under test-time background changes and visual distractors.
